meta.title: TenthMatrix: software that puts AI agents to work
meta.description: TenthMatrix designs, builds and runs AI agents, the tools they depend on and the applications teams use every day, and writes about the engineering behind them.

hero.title: Software that puts AI agents to work
hero.lede: We design, build and run AI agents and the software they depend on: gateways, secrets, release pipelines and the applications your teams use every day. You keep the data, the keys and the final say.

pillars.title: Three layers, one team
pillars.lede: Most agent projects stall between the demo and production. We build all three layers, so the handover is ours to get right.

agents.title: Agents
agents.body: Specialist agents that read tickets, inboxes and repositories, do the work, and stop for review before anything is sent, spent or deleted.

tools.title: ٹولز
tools.body: The infrastructure under the agents: an API gateway with a WAF, a secrets vault per tenant, health-gated release rings and round-the-clock monitoring.

applications.title: Applications
applications.body: Finished software for the teams that use it: agent orchestration, CRM, marketing and knowledge assistants, wired into the systems you already run.

steps.title: From one job to production in four steps
steps.lede: No platform to buy first. We start with a single task and prove the agent on it.

items.title: Scope
items.body: We pick one job with a clear owner and a measurable outcome, and write down what the agent must never do.

items.title: Build
items.body: Agents, tools and evaluations live in your repository from day one. You can read every prompt, trace and test.

items.title: Gate
items.body: Actions that send, spend or delete wait for a person. Releases move from int to prod only when health checks pass.

items.title: Run
items.body: We operate it with you, with monitoring, cost reports and a weekly review, until your team owns it.

products.title: Software we build and run
products.lede: Each one started as something our own agents needed in production.

ringPromoter.description: Promotes every release through int, test, acc and prod rings. Health gates decide, and failed checks roll back on their own.

wslProxy.description: Sits in front of your origins with live configuration, an edge cache and WAF rules. An MCP gateway for agents is on the roadmap.

wslVault.description: Envelope encryption with a key hierarchy per tenant, dynamic leases and a tamper-evident audit log. Steal the server, not the secrets.

jobshout.description: Specialist agents that work in Gmail, GitHub and live sites, stream every step and stop for your approval before anything goes out.

jev.description: Our independent series and benchmark lab on fast decision models, agent harnesses, routing and the cost of inference.

nebula.name: Nebula family
nebula.description: Rust infrastructure for agent workloads, from NebulaDB, a database with vector search and streaming RAG, to NebulaDNS, authoritative DNS with Prometheus metrics.

brandPage.title: The Lattice system
brandPage.lede: Logo, colour, type and components for TenthMatrix, shown in both themes. This page is the design review surface and is not indexed.
brandPage.logoLede: Nine cells and one more: the grid is the model, the tenth cell is the agent. The mark stays crisp at 16 px.
brandPage.paletteLede: Ink on paper, one signal. Ratios are WCAG 2.2 contrast against the theme background (text and controls) or the theme text colour (surfaces).
brandPage.contrastNote: Text needs 4.5:1, control borders 3:1. Hairlines are decorative.
brandPage.typeLede: Bricolage Grotesque for display, Instrument Sans for body and UI, IBM Plex Mono for code, data and eyebrows.
brandPage.componentsLede: Buttons, pills, cards, form controls, code and article typography, side by side in light and dark.
brandPage.iconsLede: One set, one stroke weight, accent only for the active item.
